# Uncle always recommends Berseh no matter what I ask

I've been testing the chatbot and it seems stuck. Every single time, no matter what I ask, Uncle says "Just go Berseh Food Centre lah." and nothing else.

**Steps to reproduce:**

1. Asked "any good japanese food nearby?" — got the Berseh reply.
2. Asked "where can I get chicken rice?" — got the Berseh reply.
3. Asked "somewhere with aircon please" — got the Berseh reply, again.

**Expected:** Uncle should search for places and give a proper recommendation based on what I asked, maybe with a rating or distance.

**Actual:** Same one-line reply every time, word for word.

I thought maybe my Places API key wasn't working, but I checked the dashboard and the key is definitely set and looks fine. Not sure what else to check. Anyone else seeing this?
